skill.name: azure-cost
skill.description: Analyze Azure spending, query historical costs, forecast future spend, and prepare cost optimization reports using Azure Cost Management workflows.
skill.summary: Query, forecast, and optimize Azure costs with guided Azure Cost Management workflows.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: The static findings are mostly documentation false positives: Markdown links, Azure API examples, official Azure URLs, and credential best-practice snippets. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration evidence was found. One semantic issue remains because AKS guidance includes a state-changing budget creation command that should require explicit confirmation.

remediation.issue: State-changing Azure budget command in AKS anomaly guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Label budget creation as optional and require explicit user confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: Azure CLI examples use user-provided scope placeholders.
remediation.suggestion: Validate scope strings against documented Azure scope patterns before command execution.

remediation.issue: Optimization reports may include implementation commands for changes.
remediation.suggestion: Separate analysis from change execution and mark delete, resize, and budget commands as approval required.

semantic_findings.title: State-Changing Azure Budget Command
semantic_findings.description: The AKS anomaly workflow includes an az consumption budget create example. Creating budget alerts changes Azure billing configuration and should require explicit approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited block contains a budget creation command with user-provided amount, dates, resource group, and contact email. It is legitimate FinOps guidance but has side effects in the Azure tenant.

content.user_title: Analyze Azure Costs and Forecast Spend
content.value_statement: Cloud bills are hard to explain across services, scopes, and time periods. This skill guides Azure cost queries, forecasts, and optimization reports.
actual_capabilities: Build Azure Cost Management Query API request bodies for historical cost breakdowns.
Build Forecast API request bodies for future spending projections.
Select Azure scopes for subscription, resource group, management group, and billing account analysis.
Apply guardrails for date ranges, dimensions, grouping, pagination, and rate limits.
Guide Azure Quick Review and Resource Graph checks for cost optimization opportunities.
Draft cost optimization reports with cost drivers, savings estimates, and validation notes.
limitations: Requires Azure permissions and authenticated tooling before cost data can be queried.
Does not deploy or provision Azure resources.
Forecast quality depends on available historical cost data.
Pricing estimates need validation against current Azure pricing pages.

use_cases.title: Explain Monthly Azure Bill
use_cases.description: Break down current spend by service, resource group, tag, or subscription scope.

use_cases.title: Forecast Budget Exposure
use_cases.description: Project future Azure spend and separate actual costs from forecasted costs.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Cost Cleanup
use_cases.description: Identify orphaned resources, rightsizing candidates, and savings actions with validation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Spend
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Azure cost by service for this month at subscription <subscription-id>. Ask for missing scope details first.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Cost Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a month-to-date cost breakdown by resource group and compare it with last month for subscription <subscription-id>.

prompt_templates.title: Forecast Next Quarter
prompt_templates.prompt: Forecast Azure spend through the end of next quarter for scope <scope>. Include assumptions and forecast limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Build Optimization Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized Azure cost optimization report for <scope> using actual cost data, utilization metrics, and current pricing validation.

output_examples.input: What am I spending this month by service?
output_examples.output: A service-level cost summary with total spend, top services, currency, date range, and permission notes.

output_examples.input: Forecast our subscription cost through quarter end.
output_examples.output: A forecast summary that separates actual and projected costs, lists assumptions, and flags unavailable forecast data.
A prioritized optimization report covering orphaned resources, rightsizing candidates, free tier checks, and validation steps before changes.

best_practices: Confirm the Azure scope and date range before running cost queries.
Use read-only roles and narrow scopes whenever possible.
Validate savings estimates with actual cost data and current pricing.
anti_patterns: Running broad tenant scans before the user chooses a scope.
Treating forecast output as a committed budget.
Applying deletion or resizing recommendations without owner approval.

faq.question: Does this skill need Azure credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs an authenticated Azure context with Cost Management Reader or similar read permissions.

faq.question: Can it change Azure resources?
faq.answer: It is designed for analysis. Some referenced optimization actions need explicit user approval before execution.

faq.question: Which tools does it use?
faq.answer: It guides Azure CLI, Azure MCP tools, Azure Quick Review, and Cost Management APIs where available.

faq.question: Can it forecast future costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It prepares Forecast API requests and explains forecast limits and unavailable forecast responses.

faq.question: Does it support AKS and Redis?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes focused guidance for AKS anomalies, Redis, and storage cost topics.

faq.question: Can it replace FinOps review?
faq.answer: No. It helps collect evidence and draft recommendations, but humans should validate business impact.
